mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (as a proxy for accommodative monetary policy) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower discount rates increase the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% (as a proxy for deteriorating labor market conditions) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing investors to reduce equity risk exposure and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) indicates an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (characterized by strong consumer spending and high employment), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1150.0 thousand units serves as a leading indicator of economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, HOUST below 1150.0 does not lead to negative 60d returns in at least 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions, as measured by the level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS), are associated with higher consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above its 1-year moving average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 440,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS below 440000 does not produce negative 5d returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) and housing starts (HOUST < 1150.0) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, causing investors to reduce equity risk exposure and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where INDPRO < 105.0 and HOUST < 1150.0, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) in the most recent quarter (as a proxy for economic growth) is associated with stronger corporate earnings and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 is above its 1-year moving average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
